abstract: Maintains acoustic emission monitoring calibration and crack depth gauge specifications
system_message:
You are the Non-destructive testing specialist (NDT), responsible for maintaining acoustic emission monitoring calibration records and crack depth gauge specifications for tunnel defect investigations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains acoustic emission monitoring calibration and crack depth gauge specifications（ACOU）
information_points.content:
NDT-ACOU-M1M：For Cross-borehole seismic and photogrammetric survey, calibrated acoustic crack monitoring is true as verified by the NIST-traceable calibration of its multi-channel acoustic array, and its crack depth gauge resolution is 0.6 mm under tunnel vault damp conditions.
NDT-ACOU-NA3：For Acoustic resonance and terrestrial LiDAR profiling, the continuous acoustic emission multi-channel array has completed NIST-traceable calibration, confirming calibrated acoustic crack monitoring is true. Its concrete segmental lining crack measurement probe achieves a crack depth gauge resolution of 0.4 mm under tunnel vault damp conditions.
NDT-ACOU-C2M：For Ultrasonic array and mobile laser mapping, calibrated acoustic crack monitoring is true following NIST-traceable calibration of the continuous acoustic sensors, and its crack depth gauge resolution reaches 0.4 mm for concrete segmental lining crack measurements.

information_points.title: Sonic echo testing（SONIC）
information_points.content:
NDT-SONIC-A77：For Ultrasonic array and mobile laser mapping, the candidate primary ultrasonic transducer records a sonic echo pulse frequency of 65 kHz.
NDT-SONIC-6Z3：For Acoustic resonance and terrestrial LiDAR profiling, the candidate primary ultrasonic transducer exhibits a sonic echo pulse frequency of 50 kHz during bench testing.
NDT-SONIC-WIB：For Cross-borehole seismic and photogrammetric survey, the candidate primary ultrasonic transducer operates at a sonic echo pulse frequency of 35 kHz.
